actions.description: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes @Damage[1d6[piercing]] damage and must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save. A creature that fails its save is exposed to putrid plague.
actions.name: Swarming Bites

actions.description:
The Sickened and Unconscious conditions from putrid plague don't improve on their own until the disease is cured.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:14]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect ([[/gmr 1d4 #hours]]{1d4 hours})

Stage 2 Sickened 1 (1 day)

Stage 3 Sickened 1 and Slowed 1 (1 day)

Stage 4 Unconscious (1 day)

Stage 5 dead
actions.name: Putrid Plague

actions.description: This monster doesn't have a single mind (typically because it's a swarm of smaller creatures), and is immune to mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. It is still subject to mental effects that affect all creatures in an area.
actions.name: Swarm Mind

name: Rat Swarm
publicNotes:
A swarm of rats can cause total chaos within a household or business. Contracting putrid plague is all the easier when dozens of these agitated or hungry vermin gather to bite victims en masse, making rat-hunting a viable career in many parts of the world as desperate townspeople seek relief from the disease's spread.

Rats are a ubiquitous menace, scurrying through the sewers and on the streets of nearly every settlement in the world. Though a regular rat darting underfoot might startle or even frighten the average passerby, giant rats and rat swarms are far more dangerous.
